subject: Archaeology
title: The Roanoke Colony: The Lost Colonists
description: A 60-second lesson on The Roanoke Colony: The Lost Colonists.

hook.text: In 1590, a ship returned to Roanoke Island to find 115 English colonists gone.

buildup.text: The colony was established in 1587 on the coast of present-day North Carolina.

discovery.text: War with Spain delayed White's return by three years. When he arrived, every building had been dismantled and.

twist.text: Croatoan was the name of a nearby island where friendly Native Americans lived.

climax.text: DNA studies and recent archaeological digs suggest the colonists integrated into local tribes.

punchline.text: They were not lost. They moved in with the neighbors.

quiz.question: What do recent studies suggest happened to the Roanoke colonists?
options: They were killed in a conflict with Spanish soldiers
They integrated into local Native American tribes rather than perishing
They built boats and sailed back to England on their own
